implementerProof.how: Followed every refusal with the real dispatch CLI on decisions real editors broke, using the ids parsed from the refusal text. proof.criterion: Architect's design change: every ask edit of a broken decision is refused, quoting every block with its id as data; following the named path (doc-edit deleting blocks by id, then edit-ask) ends valid with every word the agent did not delete
proof.surface: Dispatch ask-edit route and document edits through the real dispatch CLI against the real Go server and Postgres 17; decisions broken by two or three real editors in headless Chromium
proof.command: Throwaway Playwright probes W1-W5: edit-ask --urgency high; doc-edit deleting block ids parsed from the refusal; edit-ask with every option. Record https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2433#issuecomment-6483048479
proof.observed:
Each refusal exits 1, quoting every block as 'block "<id>" (<type>) reads "<markdown>"', with no shell command or --ops-json. Two lists: delete the 2nd list, then edit-ask → '- Option A
- Option B'. Three lists: both extra lists deleted in one doc-edit, then edit-ask → '- Option A
- Option B
- Option C'. Repeated label, with 'Option C' in the duplicate's list: that list is quoted whole and deleted, then edit-ask [Option A: cheap, Option A2: fast, Option C] → every word kept. Paragraph after the list: delete it, then edit-ask → valid. Nested sub-item: the list is quoted whole and deleted, then edit-ask 'Option B: only if finance agrees' → every word kept. In every final state the pages are unmarked and the row equals the options sent.
proof.negativeControl: edit-ask --urgency high on each broken decision → exit 1; document and row unchanged

findings.description: The refusal says 'delete the block or blocks to drop with a document edit … until it holds its question and at most one list'. With three lists, deleting one list per doc-edit, as 'until' suggests, is refused with only the content-rule text, because doc-edit refuses an edit that leaves the decision broken. Deleting both extra lists in one doc-edit applies. Sent to the architect; not counted as a failure, because the named step ('with a document edit', the blocks to drop) applies when the deletes go in one edit.
